items.title: I STARTED WITH NOTHING ON KEMIK ! | SPACE ENGINEERS 2 SURVIVAL - VS 2.3 - E12
items.description: Episode 11 of Space Engineers 2 Colonization Survival Welcome back to Space Engineers 2 Survival (VS 2.3)! In this episode, we complete the final contract around Palatine Station by constructing a communication array platform, and then take on the ultimate survival challenge: starting with absolutely NOTHING on planet Kemik! I left all my ships, materials, and credits behind at the Verger planetary base to see if it's possible to survive, gather raw resources, and build a fully functional hydrogen exploration ship from scratch using only Tier 1 tools on this harsh new world. If you enjoyed this video, please consider to: 👍 Click the like button 💬 Hit the comment section ☕ Uplift my coffee fund: https://ko-fi.com/qutatron 🔔 Jump aboard — subscribe! 👇 Timestamps: 00:00 - Intro & Final Palatine Contract 01:18 - Building the Communication Array & Solar Setup 06:45 - Buying Radio Modules & Completing Objectives 08:58 - Fixing Contract Bug (Admin Console) & Progression Milestone 11:35 - Arriving at Kemik Station & Depositing Gear 14:48 - Dropping on Planet Kemik (Zero Resources Challenge) 15:25 - Hand Mining Iron, Silicon, Nickel & Ice 17:56 - Setting Up the First Survival Platform & O2/H2 21:18 - Designing & Building the New Hydrogen Ship (Q1s Explorer) 28:45 - Thrusters, Gyros, Solar Panels & Final Systems 34:15 - First Flight Test, Survival Tips & Next Episode Plans 💬 Question for you: What is your go-to strategy when starting with zero resources on a new planet in Space Engineers 2? Let me know in the comments! #SpaceEngineers2 #SpaceEngineers #SpaceEngineersSurvival #Gaming #SpaceEngineersGameplay #SciFiGaming contact: qutatron@gmail.com
